verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair axis for a platform like Unity, which has editor tooling and cloud services, so the story applies. However, the pack never documents user-defined rules that fire actions on events. Build Automation's CI features and command-line automation describe build pipelines and launch-time control, not rule-on-event triggers, so they are adjacent at most and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
